subject: Tomorrow is Easter – Celebrate with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we celebrate Easter, the resurrection of Christ—a powerful symbol of the soul's victory over death and the possibility of spiritual rebirth.

Master taught that Easter represents not just a historical event, but an inner experience available to all seekers. The resurrection symbolizes the awakening of Christ consciousness within us—the realization of our divine nature.

This Easter, let us reflect on the deeper meaning of resurrection and how we can experience spiritual rebirth in our own lives.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this Easter bring you closer to the experience of Christ consciousness.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
